<!doctype html><html lang="es"><head><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><style>:root {
  --bg: #f5f3ec;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --ink: #18231d;
  --muted: #5b6a61;
  --line: #e2ded2;
  --line-strong: #cfc9b8;
  --brand: #1f4d3a;
  --brand-ink: #f3efe2;
  --brand-soft: #e6efe9;
  --ok: #1d6b45;
  --ok-soft: #e3f1e8;
  --warn: #8a5a00;
  --warn-soft: #fbefd5;
  --danger: #a3271d;
  --danger-soft: #fbe6e3;
  --info: #1d4f7a;
  --radius: 12px;
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(24 35 29 / 6%), 0 4px 16px rgb(24 35 29 / 5%);
  --sidebar: 244px;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family:
    var(--font-sans, "Figtree"),
    system-ui,
    -apple-system,
    "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
p {
  margin: 0;
}

h1 {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

h2 {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

h3 {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-top: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

button,
input,
select,
textarea {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #2f7d5d;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.muted {
  color: var(--muted);
}
.small {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}
.center {
  text-align: center;
}
.pad {
  padding: 12px 16px;
}
.danger-text {
  color: var(--danger) !important;
}

/* Layout */
.shell {
  min-height: 100dvh;
}
.sidebar {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0 auto 0 0;
  width: var(--sidebar);
  background: var(--brand);
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  padding: 20px 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  z-index: 30;
}
.sidebar-brand {
  padding: 2px 10px 6px;
}
.sidebar-brand img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 196px;
  height: auto;
}
.topbar-logo {
  height: 30px;
  width: auto;
}
.seller-logo {
  display: block;
  height: 34px;
  width: auto;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.login-logo {
  width: min(380px, 100%);
  height: auto;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.nav-title {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.6;
  padding: 0 10px 6px;
}
.nav-item {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  color: inherit;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  opacity: 0.86;
}
.nav-item:hover {
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 8%);
  opacity: 1;
}
.nav-item.active {
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 16%);
  opacity: 1;
  font-weight: 650;
}
.nav-item:focus-visible,
.sidebar .btn:focus-visible {
  outline-color: #d9f0c9;
}
.sidebar-foot {
  margin-top: auto;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 0 10px;
}
.sidebar-foot .muted {
  color: rgb(243 239 226 / 70%);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.sidebar .btn {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 30%);
}
.topbar {
  display: none;
}
.main {
  margin-left: var(--sidebar);
  padding: 28px 32px 64px;
}
.page {
  max-width: 1180px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
}
.page-head,
.card-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.head-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}
.grid-2 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: start;
}
.loading,
.empty {
  color: var(--muted);
  padding: 18px 16px;
}
.scrim {
  display: none;
}

/* Cards and stats */
.card {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.card.narrow {
  max-width: 460px;
}
.center-screen {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 24px;
}
.stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.stats.compact {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
}
.stat {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--line-strong);
  min-width: 0;
}
.stat.ok {
  border-left-color: var(--ok);
}
.stat.warn {
  border-left-color: #d79a1e;
}
.stat.danger {
  border-left-color: var(--danger);
}
.stat-label {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.stat-value {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.stat-hint {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}
button.stat {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  width: 100%;
}
button.stat:hover,
button.stat.active {
  border-color: var(--brand);
  border-left-color: var(--brand);
}
button.stat.active {
  background: var(--brand-soft);
}
.stat-more {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--brand);
  text-decoration: underline;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.filter-note {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px 10px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* Buttons */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background: var(--surface);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--brand);
}
.btn.primary {
  background: var(--brand);
  border-color: var(--brand);
  color: #fff;
}
.btn.primary:hover {
  background: #173b2c;
}
.btn.danger {
  background: var(--danger);
  border-color: var(--danger);
  color: #fff;
}
.btn.small {
  min-height: 34px;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}
.btn.full {
  width: 100%;
}
.btn.link {
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  min-height: 32px;
  color: var(--brand);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.icon-btn {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: none;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  flex: none;
}
.icon-btn:hover {
  background: rgb(24 35 29 / 7%);
}

/* Toolbar */
.toolbar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}
.search {
  flex: 1 1 240px;
  max-width: 380px;
}
.segmented {
  display: inline-flex;
  background: #e9e5d8;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 3px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.segmented button {
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  min-height: 36px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}
.segmented button.active {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%);
}

/* Forms */
input,
select,
textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #fff;
}
input[type="checkbox"] {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0;
  accent-color: var(--brand);
  flex: none;
}
select:disabled,
input:disabled {
  background: #f1eee5;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}
.field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 5px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.field > span {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #34433a;
}
.form-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.line {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: end;
}
.line-block {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line);
}
.line-hint {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.check {
  display: flex;
  gap: 9px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}
.check.warn {
  background: var(--warn-soft);
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  color: #5c3c00;
}
.actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.total-line {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: var(--brand-soft);
  border-radius: 9px;
}
.note {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #eef1ee;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}
.note.danger {
  background: var(--danger-soft);
  color: #7a1c15;
}
.note.ok {
  background: var(--ok-soft);
  color: #14502f;
}

/* Tables */
.table-wrap {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.table-wrap.flat {
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  border-radius: 0;
}
.table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}
.table th {
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: #faf8f2;
}
.table td {
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  vertical-align: top;
}
.table tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.table tfoot td {
  font-weight: 700;
  background: #f1eee4;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.table .num {
  text-align: right;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.table td small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  white-space: normal;
}
.table tr.clickable {
  cursor: pointer;
}
.table tr.clickable:hover td,
.table tr.selected td {
  background: #f3f7f3;
}
.table tr.voided td {
  color: var(--muted);
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
.cell-btn {
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-weight: 650;
  color: var(--brand);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}
.badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 2px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: #ece9df;
  color: #4a554d;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.badge.ok {
  background: var(--ok-soft);
  color: #14502f;
}
.badge.warn {
  background: var(--warn-soft);
  color: #6b4500;
}
.badge.danger {
  background: var(--danger-soft);
  color: #7a1c15;
}

/* Lists */
.list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
}
.list li + li {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.row-btn,
.row-static {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 4px;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.row-static {
  cursor: default;
}
.row-btn:hover {
  background: #f3f7f3;
}
.row-btn span,
.row-static span {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 0;
}
.row-btn small,
.row-static small {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}
.right {
  text-align: right;
  flex: none;
}

/* Facts */
.facts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px 18px;
  margin: 14px 0 0;
}
.facts div {
  min-width: 0;
}
.facts dt {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.facts dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.facts.result {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.facts.result div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.facts.result div:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.facts.result dt {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.facts.result .strong {
  background: var(--brand-soft);
}
.facts.result .strong dd {
  font-weight: 750;
}
.files {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.file-link {
  color: var(--info);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
button.file-link {
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  padding: 0;
  font-family: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.file-slot {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 4px 10px;
}
.file-add {
  color: var(--brand);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.file-add.busy {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: progress;
}

/* Bars */
.bars {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 170px;
}
.bar-col {
  flex: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr auto;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.bar-track {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
}
.bar-fill {
  width: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2f7d5d, var(--brand));
  border-radius: 6px 6px 2px 2px;
}
.bar-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Cash counter */
.bills {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}
.bill {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(0, 1fr) 100px;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
}
.bill > span:first-child {
  font-weight: 650;
}
.bill-total {
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--muted);
}

/* Modal */
.modal {
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  width: min(560px, calc(100vw - 24px));
  max-width: none;
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 24px);
  color: var(--ink);
}
.modal.wide {
  width: min(860px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
.modal::backdrop {
  background: rgb(18 28 22 / 55%);
}
.modal-box {
  background: var(--surface);
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 24px);
}
.modal-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 14px 14px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.modal-head h2 {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.modal-body {
  padding: 18px 20px 22px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.modal-body {
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
.modal .stat {
  padding: 10px 12px;
}
.modal .stat-value {
  font-size: 1.02rem;
}
.modal-body .table th,
.modal-body .table td {
  padding-left: 8px;
  padding-right: 8px;
}

.toast {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 24px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--ink);
  color: #fff;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  z-index: 100;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
}

/* Login */
.login {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.login-brand {
  background: var(--brand);
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  padding: 56px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
}
.login-brand h1 {
  font-size: 2.1rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
  max-width: 14ch;
}
.login-brand p {
  opacity: 0.8;
  max-width: 36ch;
}
.eyebrow {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  font-weight: 700;
  opacity: 0.75;
}
.brand-mark {
  color: #b9d8a8;
}
.login-panel {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 32px 20px;
}
.login-form {
  width: min(380px, 100%);
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}
.login-form h2 {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
}

/* Seller portal */
.seller-head {
  background: var(--brand);
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  padding: 18px 24px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.seller-head .btn {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 30%);
}
.brand-small {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.75;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.seller-main {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 22px 20px 56px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .topbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 20;
    background: var(--brand);
    color: var(--brand-ink);
    padding: 8px 12px;
  }
  .topbar .icon-btn {
    color: inherit;
  }
  .topbar-title {
    font-weight: 700;
    flex: 1;
  }
  .sidebar {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    width: min(290px, 86vw);
  }
  .sidebar.open {
    transform: none;
  }
  .scrim {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgb(18 28 22 / 50%);
    z-index: 25;
  }
  .main {
    margin-left: 0;
    padding: 18px 14px 56px;
  }
  .grid-2 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .login {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .login-brand {
    padding: 32px 24px;
  }
  .login-brand h1 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    max-width: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .hide-sm {
    display: none;
  }
  .stats {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .stat-value {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
  }
  .table th,
  .table td {
    padding: 9px 10px;
  }
  .line {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  }
  .line .grow {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  .modal-body {
    padding: 14px 14px 18px;
  }

<!doctype html><html lang="es"><head><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><style>:root {
  --bg: #f5f3ec;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --ink: #18231d;
  --muted: #5b6a61;
  --line: #e2ded2;
  --line-strong: #cfc9b8;
  --brand: #1f4d3a;
  --brand-ink: #f3efe2;
  --brand-soft: #e6efe9;
  --ok: #1d6b45;
  --ok-soft: #e3f1e8;
  --warn: #8a5a00;
  --warn-soft: #fbefd5;
  --danger: #a3271d;
  --danger-soft: #fbe6e3;
  --info: #1d4f7a;
  --radius: 12px;
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(24 35 29 / 6%), 0 4px 16px rgb(24 35 29 / 5%);
  --sidebar: 244px;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family:
    var(--font-sans, "Figtree"),
    system-ui,
    -apple-system,
    "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
p {
  margin: 0;
}

h1 {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

h2 {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

h3 {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-top: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

button,
input,
select,
textarea {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #2f7d5d;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.muted {
  color: var(--muted);
}
.small {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}
.center {
  text-align: center;
}
.pad {
  padding: 12px 16px;
}
.danger-text {
  color: var(--danger) !important;
}

/* Layout */
.shell {
  min-height: 100dvh;
}
.sidebar {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0 auto 0 0;
  width: var(--sidebar);
  background: var(--brand);
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  padding: 20px 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  z-index: 30;
}
.sidebar-brand {
  padding: 2px 10px 6px;
}
.sidebar-brand img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 196px;
  height: auto;
}
.topbar-logo {
  height: 30px;
  width: auto;
}
.seller-logo {
  display: block;
  height: 34px;
  width: auto;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.login-logo {
  width: min(380px, 100%);
  height: auto;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.nav-title {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.6;
  padding: 0 10px 6px;
}
.nav-item {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  color: inherit;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  opacity: 0.86;
}
.nav-item:hover {
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 8%);
  opacity: 1;
}
.nav-item.active {
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 16%);
  opacity: 1;
  font-weight: 650;
}
.nav-item:focus-visible,
.sidebar .btn:focus-visible {
  outline-color: #d9f0c9;
}
.sidebar-foot {
  margin-top: auto;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 0 10px;
}
.sidebar-foot .muted {
  color: rgb(243 239 226 / 70%);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.sidebar .btn {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 30%);
}
.topbar {
  display: none;
}
.main {
  margin-left: var(--sidebar);
  padding: 28px 32px 64px;
}
.page {
  max-width: 1180px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
}
.page-head,
.card-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.head-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}
.grid-2 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: start;
}
.loading,
.empty {
  color: var(--muted);
  padding: 18px 16px;
}
.scrim {
  display: none;
}

/* Cards and stats */
.card {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.card.narrow {
  max-width: 460px;
}
.center-screen {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 24px;
}
.stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.stats.compact {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
}
.stat {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--line-strong);
  min-width: 0;
}
.stat.ok {
  border-left-color: var(--ok);
}
.stat.warn {
  border-left-color: #d79a1e;
}
.stat.danger {
  border-left-color: var(--danger);
}
.stat-label {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.stat-value {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.stat-hint {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}
button.stat {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  width: 100%;
}
button.stat:hover,
button.stat.active {
  border-color: var(--brand);
  border-left-color: var(--brand);
}
button.stat.active {
  background: var(--brand-soft);
}
.stat-more {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--brand);
  text-decoration: underline;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.filter-note {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px 10px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* Buttons */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background: var(--surface);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--brand);
}
.btn.primary {
  background: var(--brand);
  border-color: var(--brand);
  color: #fff;
}
.btn.primary:hover {
  background: #173b2c;
}
.btn.danger {
  background: var(--danger);
  border-color: var(--danger);
  color: #fff;
}
.btn.small {
  min-height: 34px;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}
.btn.full {
  width: 100%;
}
.btn.link {
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  min-height: 32px;
  color: var(--brand);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.icon-btn {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: none;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  flex: none;
}
.icon-btn:hover {
  background: rgb(24 35 29 / 7%);
}

/* Toolbar */
.toolbar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}
.search {
  flex: 1 1 240px;
  max-width: 380px;
}
.segmented {
  display: inline-flex;
  background: #e9e5d8;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 3px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.segmented button {
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  min-height: 36px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}
.segmented button.active {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%);
}

/* Forms */
input,
select,
textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #fff;
}
input[type="checkbox"] {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0;
  accent-color: var(--brand);
  flex: none;
}
select:disabled,
input:disabled {
  background: #f1eee5;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}
.field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 5px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.field > span {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #34433a;
}
.form-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.line {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: end;
}
.line-block {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line);
}
.line-hint {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.check {
  display: flex;
  gap: 9px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}
.check.warn {
  background: var(--warn-soft);
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  color: #5c3c00;
}
.actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.total-line {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: var(--brand-soft);
  border-radius: 9px;
}
.note {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #eef1ee;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}
.note.danger {
  background: var(--danger-soft);
  color: #7a1c15;
}
.note.ok {
  background: var(--ok-soft);
  color: #14502f;
}

/* Tables */
.table-wrap {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.table-wrap.flat {
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  border-radius: 0;
}
.table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}
.table th {
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: #faf8f2;
}
.table td {
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  vertical-align: top;
}
.table tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.table tfoot td {
  font-weight: 700;
  background: #f1eee4;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.table .num {
  text-align: right;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.table td small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  white-space: normal;
}
.table tr.clickable {
  cursor: pointer;
}
.table tr.clickable:hover td,
.table tr.selected td {
  background: #f3f7f3;
}
.table tr.voided td {
  color: var(--muted);
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
.cell-btn {
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-weight: 650;
  color: var(--brand);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}
.badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 2px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: #ece9df;
  color: #4a554d;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.badge.ok {
  background: var(--ok-soft);
  color: #14502f;
}
.badge.warn {
  background: var(--warn-soft);
  color: #6b4500;
}
.badge.danger {
  background: var(--danger-soft);
  color: #7a1c15;
}

/* Lists */
.list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
}
.list li + li {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.row-btn,
.row-static {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 4px;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.row-static {
  cursor: default;
}
.row-btn:hover {
  background: #f3f7f3;
}
.row-btn span,
.row-static span {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 0;
}
.row-btn small,
.row-static small {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}
.right {
  text-align: right;
  flex: none;
}

/* Facts */
.facts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px 18px;
  margin: 14px 0 0;
}
.facts div {
  min-width: 0;
}
.facts dt {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.facts dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.facts.result {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.facts.result div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.facts.result div:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.facts.result dt {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.facts.result .strong {
  background: var(--brand-soft);
}
.facts.result .strong dd {
  font-weight: 750;
}
.files {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.file-link {
  color: var(--info);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
button.file-link {
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  padding: 0;
  font-family: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.file-slot {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 4px 10px;
}
.file-add {
  color: var(--brand);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.file-add.busy {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: progress;
}

/* Bars */
.bars {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 170px;
}
.bar-col {
  flex: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr auto;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.bar-track {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
}
.bar-fill {
  width: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2f7d5d, var(--brand));
  border-radius: 6px 6px 2px 2px;
}
.bar-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Cash counter */
.bills {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}
.bill {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(0, 1fr) 100px;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
}
.bill > span:first-child {
  font-weight: 650;
}
.bill-total {
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--muted);
}

/* Modal */
.modal {
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  width: min(560px, calc(100vw - 24px));
  max-width: none;
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 24px);
  color: var(--ink);
}
.modal.wide {
  width: min(860px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
.modal::backdrop {
  background: rgb(18 28 22 / 55%);
}
.modal-box {
  background: var(--surface);
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 24px);
}
.modal-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 14px 14px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.modal-head h2 {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.modal-body {
  padding: 18px 20px 22px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.modal-body {
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
.modal .stat {
  padding: 10px 12px;
}
.modal .stat-value {
  font-size: 1.02rem;
}
.modal-body .table th,
.modal-body .table td {
  padding-left: 8px;
  padding-right: 8px;
}

.toast {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 24px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--ink);
  color: #fff;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  z-index: 100;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
}

/* Login */
.login {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.login-brand {
  background: var(--brand);
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  padding: 56px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
}
.login-brand h1 {
  font-size: 2.1rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
  max-width: 14ch;
}
.login-brand p {
  opacity: 0.8;
  max-width: 36ch;
}
.eyebrow {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  font-weight: 700;
  opacity: 0.75;
}
.brand-mark {
  color: #b9d8a8;
}
.login-panel {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 32px 20px;
}
.login-form {
  width: min(380px, 100%);
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}
.login-form h2 {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
}

/* Seller portal */
.seller-head {
  background: var(--brand);
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  padding: 18px 24px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.seller-head .btn {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--brand-ink);
  border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 30%);
}
.brand-small {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.75;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.seller-main {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 22px 20px 56px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .topbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 20;
    background: var(--brand);
    color: var(--brand-ink);
    padding: 8px 12px;
  }
  .topbar .icon-btn {
    color: inherit;
  }
  .topbar-title {
    font-weight: 700;
    flex: 1;
  }
  .sidebar {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    width: min(290px, 86vw);
  }
  .sidebar.open {
    transform: none;
  }
  .scrim {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgb(18 28 22 / 50%);
    z-index: 25;
  }
  .main {
    margin-left: 0;
    padding: 18px 14px 56px;
  }
  .grid-2 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .login {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .login-brand {
    padding: 32px 24px;
  }
  .login-brand h1 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    max-width: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .hide-sm {
    display: none;
  }
  .stats {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .stat-value {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
  }
  .table th,
  .table td {
    padding: 9px 10px;
  }
  .line {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  }
  .line .grow {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  .modal-body {
    padding: 14px 14px 18px;
  }
  .search {
    max-width: none;
  }
  h1 {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .sidebar {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* Los teléfonos agrandan toda la página al tocar un campo con letra pequeña, y la app
   instalada se queda agrandada. Con campos de 16px eso no pasa. */
@media (max-width: 900px), (pointer: coarse) {
  input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]),
  select,
  textarea {
    font-size: 16px;
  }
}
@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) {
  body {
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
  }
}

/* Vista previa del portal del vendedor (solo administrador) */
.portal-preview {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 60;
  overflow: auto;
  background: var(--bg);
}
.preview-note {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 8px 24px;
  background: var(--brand-soft);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}

/* Firmas */
.signature-pad-empty,
.signature-pad-preview {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 110px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--brand);
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.signature-pad-preview .signature-view {
  max-height: 100px;
}
/* Panel a pantalla completa solo para firmar */
.signature-panel {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right))
    max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left));
  background: var(--surface);
  touch-action: none;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
}
.signature-panel header {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  color: var(--muted, #6b7770);
}
.signature-panel header b {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.signature-panel-canvas {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.signature-panel-canvas svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - 190px) * 600 / 340));
  max-height: 100%;
  background: #fff;
  border: 2px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  touch-action: none;
  cursor: crosshair;
}
.signature-panel footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  gap: 10px;
}
.signature-panel footer .btn {
  min-height: 50px;
}
.signature-panel footer .btn.primary {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}
@media (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 520px) {
  .signature-panel {
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    padding-top: 8px;
  }
  .signature-panel header {
    flex: 1 1 100%;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .signature-panel-canvas {
    flex: 1 1 60%;
  }
  .signature-panel-canvas svg {
    max-width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - 60px) * 600 / 340));
  }
  .signature-panel footer {
    flex: 0 0 150px;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .signature-panel footer .btn.primary {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }
}
.signature-panel path,
.signature-view path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: #10194a;
  stroke-width: 3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}
.signature-view path {
  stroke-width: 2;
}
.signature-guide {
  stroke: var(--line-strong);
  stroke-width: 1;
}
.signature-pad-foot {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.signature-view {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 260px;
  aspect-ratio: 3 / 1;
}
.sign-blocks {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}
.sign-block {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  align-content: end;
}
.sign-block .signature-view {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
  min-height: 70px;
}
.share-link {
  display: block;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: var(--brand-soft);
  border-radius: 9px;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  user-select: all;
}

/* Varias empresas en la misma app: selector y nombre cuando la empresa no tiene logo. */
.brand-text {
  display: block;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  padding: 6px 0 2px;
}
.brand-text.small {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  padding: 0;
}
.company-switch {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 6px 6px 14px;
  padding: 4px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgb(0 0 0 / 18%);
}
.company-btn {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: none;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 7px 6px;
  opacity: 0.75;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.company-btn:hover {
  opacity: 1;
}
.company-btn.active {
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 18%);
  font-weight: 650;
  opacity: 1;
}
.company-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #d9f0c9;
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

/* Factura para firmar: páginas una debajo de otra con el campo de firma marcado. */
.invoice-pages {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
}

.invoice-page {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

.invoice-page img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

.invoice-pages.picking .invoice-page {
  cursor: crosshair;
}

.invoice-page-wait {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.invoice-page-num {
  position: absolute;
  right: 8px;
  bottom: 8px;
  padding: 1px 8px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: rgb(24 35 29 / 70%);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.invoice-spot {
  position: absolute;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  border: 2px dashed #c47a00;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgb(255 196 0 / 22%);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: invoice-spot-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.invoice-spot.signed {
  border-color: transparent;
  background: transparent;
  animation: none;
}

@keyframes invoice-spot-pulse {
  50% {
    background: rgb(255 196 0 / 38%);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .invoice-spot {
    animation: none;
  }
}

.invoice-spot-label {
  margin: auto;
  padding: 0 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #c47a00;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.invoice-spot-sign {
  flex: 1 1 74%;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
}

.invoice-spot-sign path {
  stroke: rgb(13 38 110) !important;
}

.invoice-spot-caption {
  flex: 0 0 26%;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #2a2a2a;
  font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(5px, 1.4vw, 9px);
  line-height: 1.1;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.spot-tools {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
}

.share-link {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--bg);
  font-size: 13px;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.invoice-sign-status {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--surface);
}

/* Seasonal presentation only; business states and document views keep their semantics. */
:is(.shell, .seller, .login) {
  --brand: #08473e;
  --brand-soft: #e6efeb;
  --bg: #f7f4ed;
  --holiday-gold: #dfc38c;
  background: var(--bg);
}

.holiday-green {
  isolation: isolate;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 65% 10%, #126153 0%, transparent 67%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #08473e, #052e2b);
}

.holiday-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
}

.holiday-snow {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #fff;
}

.holiday-flake {
  position: absolute;
  top: -18px;
  width: var(--flake-size);
  height: 100%;
  opacity: var(--flake-opacity);
  animation: holiday-snowfall 20s linear infinite;
}

.holiday-flake svg,
.holiday-flake i {
  display: block;
  width: var(--flake-size);
  height: var(--flake-size);
}

.holiday-flake i { background: currentColor; border-radius: 50%; }

@keyframes holiday-snowfall {
  from { transform: translate3d(-8px, -5%, 0); }
  to { transform: translate3d(10px, 110%, 0); }
}

.holiday-corner {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 215px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.95;
}

.sidebar.holiday-green { border-right: 1px solid #be9b5840; padding-top: 34px; }
.sidebar > :not(.holiday-backdrop),
.topbar > :not(.holiday-backdrop),
.login-brand > :not(.holiday-backdrop),
.seller-head > :not(.holiday-backdrop) { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.sidebar .holiday-corner { width: 140px; transform: scaleX(-1); right: auto; left: 0; top: -39px; }
.sidebar .nav-item.active { background: #ffffff1f; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 #dfc38c; }
.sidebar .nav-item { text-shadow: 0 1px 5px #052e2b; }
.sidebar .company-switch { background: #001b194f; }
.sidebar:not(.open) .holiday-motion { animation-play-state: running; }

.holiday-banner {
  position: relative;

  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 188px;
  border: 1px solid #b59b623b;
  border-radius: 14px;
  color: #f7f4ed;

.holiday-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 22px 150px 0 24px; }

.holiday-copy p { font-size: 0.87rem; margin-top: 6px; color: #f3efe2d9; }
.holiday-banner .holiday-corner { width: 180px; }
.holiday-fields { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 55px; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.6; }

/* The flight has its own row below the greeting; it cannot cross text or controls. */
.holiday-flight {

  z-index: 1;
  width: 100%;
  height: 90px;

  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;

.holiday-sleigh-mover { position: absolute; inset: 8px 0 0; animation: holiday-flight 30s linear infinite; animation-delay: -7s; }

}

}
